items.html: This is the secret of “and He placed [the cherubim] at the east of the Garden of Eden.” Also, the face of Tevuna, whose gematria is 544, is the secret of “the east [Kedmat] of Eden,” to indicate that above, this was in the aspect of the back in the upper Bina, whereas here it is the face, which is Kedmat, from the language of “You formed me behind and before,” as mentioned in the Zohar.
